values.note: ReserveAmerica sells 21 sites (no site 13): 11 tent-only, 3 pop-up/tent (15-20 ft) and 7 standard non-electric. Four take a 23-ft rig, all 25-ft back-ins: sites 06 and 11 in the 1-11 & 22 loop, 15 and 18 in the 12-21 loop. Sites 17, 19 and 20 are rated 15 ft. Every site is back-in.

note: MA DCR campground in pine woods on the Connecticut line, in the Halfway Brook area of Granville State Forest; trails follow the Hubbard River's cascades and pools. Remote: DCR says the closest general store is 15 miles away. Black bears visit: food lockers at every site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica + mass.gov: $17/$54 (2026 fee table), no hookups, no dump station, flush toilets + hot showers, reservations required, 2026 season 5/15-9/6 Fri/Sat/Sun nights only (matches stored; no 2027 schedule posted), 22 sites. Added max_rig_ft 25 (four 25-ft back-ins: 06, 11, 15, 18), back-in only, RA booking url; hookups/facilities/booking moved from derived to manual. Not waterfront kept (Halfway Brook is a small brook; RA tags no site Near Water). Pin left as is (see flag).
